newsitem.title: UK: Rolls Royce signs China training agreement.
newsitem.headline: Rolls Royce signs China training agreement.

text.p: British engineering group Rolls Royce Plc said on Wednesday it had signed an agreement with China's State Planning Commission to help train macroeconomics manager/planners and organisers from large state-run businesses.

Rolls Royce said the programme would study factors affecting the development of the British economy, the role of central government and the relationships between central and local government and private enterprises. Under the programme senior economic planners will spend two weeks in Britain.
The company said it had run training programmes in China for many years covering aero-engine technology and general management theory.
